props.name: defaultPages

props.description: Renders only the rows in view, for thousands of items. Install `@tanstack/react-virtual` 3.14 or later, and pass `<CommandVirtual.List />` as `Command.List`'s `render`. Import it from `@elmeragroup/fuse/command-virtual`, which the root barrel leaves out, so an app without the virtualizer never loads it. A virtual list renders flat items only, so `virtualized` beside `grouped` throws.
